name: Open a prompt from the design system
description: Opens the design system's list of prompts and blocking screens, opens the update prompt on sample data, and closes it. A purely visual check: nothing is updated, recorded or paid.
details: Developer entry copied from the existing design-system captures. The prompt is the app's own, drawn from sample data in the prompt flow; ds-prompt-open marks a sample on show and Not now closes it without recording a dismissal. Only the first row is exercised: the rest need scrolling and are covered by designSystemPrompts.test.tsx. No native run yet.
